policies.METADATA_COMMENT: Source/licence/version/attribution or diagnostic-probe comment. Suppress candidate extraction; preserve offsets.

policies.UNKNOWN_COMMENT: No match to metadata patterns; keep as review-required; do not silently suppress.

expectedImpact.baseline: A4 and A4.1 artifacts and metrics remain unchanged.
